title: Graded n-Absorbing Ideals and their Combinatorial Structure
summary: Graded $n$-absorbing ideals generalize graded prime ideals by extending absorption properties to products of $(n+1)$ homogeneous elements. We study several generalizations of graded prime ideals, including graded $n$-absorbing, graded weakly $n$-absorbing, graded strongly $n$-absorbing, and graded $n$-absorbing primary ideals, as well as related graded $n$-absorbing subgroups. Our primary result establishes a combinatorial model for graded $n$-absorbing principal monomial ideals in polynomial rings with the standard grading.
